findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Functional. The new remote-state path makes started parts and fixes visible without a local worktree, but `_item` still gives a started item `Next: forge work <item>`. `worker.checkout` refuses that command when the item has no checkout (`worker.py:74–77`). In a second clone, `forge next` therefore offers a runnable command that immediately fails for work started by a teammate. The same gap affects remote items in fixing or checks-failed states.
findings.title: Remote started items offer a command that cannot run here
